description: This file provides helper methods for generating JWT access tokens for test users with specified roles, used within integration tests for the Public API.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate JWT tokens for admin and normal users for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user with 'Administrators' role.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user with no roles.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for a given username and roles using a secret key.
